This geographical mix give us strong long-term visibility on organic growth even in a challenging macroeconomic environment. [#90](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-90)

Second question regarding the sequence of the organic growth and impact of the slowdown of signature at the end of the year. [#622](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-622)

Organic growth reached 3.8%, supported by continued structural outsourcing trends and solid commercial momentum across most geographies. [#45](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-45)
Some zones are pretty solid like France, Central Europe, above 3%. [#217](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-217)

In the heat map, we are looking at -- green countries represent markets where we see significant structural headroom for development, whether in terms of outsourcing penetration, service portfolio, depth of customer segmentation. [#83](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-83)
So that's why probably less organic growth in H1 and more organic growth in H2, as I said. [#788](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-788)
Together, these elements should continue to translate into sustainable EPS growth over time. [#287](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-287)
We expect organic growth to be slightly below the level achieved in '25. [#464](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-464)
At constant exchange rate, growth reached 5.5% with organic growth of 3.8%. [#22](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-22)
So we will have a solid year of organic growth and I think margin improvement in LatAm in '26. [#590](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-590)
The rollout will continue across the group over the next 3 years and represents a significant lever for future organic growth. [#125](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-125)

But maybe just a further update on the organic trajectory in the business that you're seeing at the moment and the kind of move that your larger customers and your small, medium-sized customers are in, given the economic environment in Europe at the moment? [#606](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-606)
Overall, this performance reflects a healthy balance between organic growth, bolt-on acquisitions and disciplined pricing. [#52](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-52)
and Ireland, organic growth reached 2.6% despite macroeconomic headwinds. [#161](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-161)

The underlying growth trends might be different today from what they were a decade or 2 decades ago, but nevertheless, the industry continues to grow. [#60](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-60)
Recent acquisitions contributed 5.1% to the region's annual growth. [#150](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-150)
So I will not specifically highlight one specific area where we will increase more. [#573](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-573)
As a result, coverage progressively builds over time. [#439](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-439)
So probably a growth that will be better in H2 '23 than H1 of '26. [#628](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-628)

Rather than reviewing each country individually, the objective here is to provide a clear picture of relative market maturity across our footprint. [#82](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-82)
So which regions do you expect margin expansion to be tougher this year, I guess, given the guide for a slight improvement overall? [#732](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-732)
Nevertheless, when we see the breakdown by country and so on, we still have some region where we could be even more efficient. [#679](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-679)

And when we will analyze the sequence of the organic growth of the group, what we expect because it is signed, not already put in place, and it is the installation of the contracts that will arrive around summer for some contracts. [#624](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-624)
We are also targeting specific growth pockets, for example, resident [ cleaning ] services in the U.K. [#76](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-76)

And last, the expansion of our network, which over time, has led to a more balanced geographical and end market mix and developed growth opportunities, thanks to outsourcing potential. [#412](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-412)

It is worth noting that this resilience, as well as the organic growth profile of the group, improved further with the expansion in Latin America and the acquisition of Berendsen. [#421](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-421)
In many cases, acquiring capacity is more efficient and faster than building a new plant from scratch. [#110](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-110)

As density increases and capabilities expand locally, these markets can progressively unlock the same levers, broader service penetration, deeper cross-selling and access to a wider customer base. [#89](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-89)

Regarding the second part of your question, the origin of the growth, it is a good mix between cross-selling and pure [ virgin account ]. [#682](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-682)

Constant ForEx, you can see the balance of the portfolio, we were speaking about Southern Europe, Latin America delivered very substantial organic growth in the high single digits. [#216](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-216)

So that's why at this level of the year, we are quite confident to see at least the same margin in LatAm in '26, and more probably, an improvement of the margin in the sector where we continue to have a solid organic growth momentum. [#587](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-587)
Let me now comment on revenue growth and EBITDA margin evolution across the group. [#214](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-214)

And which end markets or geographies do you see the greatest opportunity for productivity gains, which I think is the main reason for your expectation of continued margin expansion? [#566](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-566)

Most regions contributed positively to this improvement, Southern Europe recording 1 point margin increase, reflecting strong operational leverage and favorable energy procurement condition. [#227](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-227)
Please note that now, all regions are above 32%. [#226](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-226)

This confirms our ability to continue expanding margins even in the context of cost inflation and regulatory headwinds in certain regions. [#25](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-25)
Let's now take a look at each of our geographies. [#142](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-142)

In terms of geographies, France represents 29% of our total turnover, and we have a balanced mix with Central Europe and Scandinavia being more mature and Southern Europe, Latin America, offering higher growth prospects. [#209](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-209)
Productivity gains, as always, everywhere, we target 2% to 3% productivity gains, and it is well spread all across our geographies. [#572](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-572)

We pursued the further rollout of our service offering across all geographies, expanding both our client base and our penetration within existing accounts. [#36](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-36)

Growth was particularly supported by strong performance in hospitality, while we also continue to expand our workwear outsourcing offering across the region. [#176](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-176)
This ensures balance sheet strength while preserving capacity for growth. [#494](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-494)
The slight EBITDA margin improvement was driven by volume growth and continued improvements in industrial processes. [#145](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-145)

Overall, this slide illustrates once again the resilience of our model, solid top line growth at constant ForEx, combined with continued margin expansion at group level despite regional headwinds. [#235](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-235)

Let me first walk you through the usual revenue breakdown by activity, end market and geography to illustrate the group's strong diversification, which provides us with a resilient model in times of economic slowdown. [#203](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-203)
And also in terms of the like-for-like growth, how much of that was cross-selling versus kind of stand-alone Pest Control sales? [#668](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-668)
So it's the global picture that we have at this stage of the year regarding evolution of the margin, globally speaking for '26. [#753](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-753)
It doesn't change a lot, the EPS growth for '26. [#765](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-765)

Importantly, this did not constrain growth, as investment levels remained fully aligned with commercial development and contract rates. [#298](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-298)

As you can see, most of the deals completed in '25 were aimed either at consolidating our market position in geographies where we already operate or at securing additional industrial capacity. [#109](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-109)

This performance was notably driven by strengthened energy efficiency programs, energy transition initiatives at certain sites and improvements in country-level emission factors. [#367](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-367)

Moving on to the next slide, I would like to provide an update on our Pest Control and Cleanroom businesses, which remain high-growth and high-margin activities within the group. [#128](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-128)

The contribution of our 4 end markets, which all have different growth drivers, ranges from 18% for trade and services to 30% for health care. [#207](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-207)

The competitive environment in Denmark, while still challenging, gradually improved throughout the year, and FX was a tailwind in the region. [#157](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-157)
We expect continued growth and further margin improvement, combined with disciplined capital allocation. [#555](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-555)
